items.title: Respond to contract extension offer
items.quote: Ihre Entscheidung erbitten wir binnen 6 Werktagen ab Datum dieses Schreibens; als Werktage zählen dabei Montag bis Samstag, gesetzliche Feiertage nicht.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 16.04.2027. This is the triggering event (§187 Abs.1 BGB by analogy, as instructed for private deadlines), so 16.04.2027 itself is not counted; counting starts 17.04.2027. Employer defines Werktage as Monday–Saturday, excluding statutory holidays. Count: Day1=Sat 17.04.2027; Sun 18.04.2027 is not a Werktag under this definition so it is skipped and not counted; Day2=Mon 19.04.2027; Day3=Tue 20.04.2027; Day4=Wed 21.04.2027; Day5=Thu 22.04.2027; Day6=Fri 23.04.2027. No NRW public holidays fall in this window (Easter 2027: Good Friday 26.03, Easter Monday 29.03, both before this period). The 6th Werktag is Friday 23.04.2027, which is already a working day, so no further weekend/holiday shift is needed.
